aiDialog.title: Create a skill with AI
aiDialog.description: Describe how the assistant should do this kind of work. The AI writes a draft of your own skill; nothing is activated, installed or shared.
aiDialog.instructionPlaceholder: Plan 60-second product videos: a hook in the first 3 seconds, three benefits, one call to action.
aiDialog.costHint: Creating a draft uses credits for one AI request. Retrying the same request is not charged again.
aiDialog.created: AI draft created. Review it under Mine, then test and activate it.

errors.budget: Creating a draft needs credits or a spending approval. Add credits or approve the spend, then try again.
errors.provider: The AI model is not available right now. Nothing was charged; try again later.
errors.output: The AI answer could not become a valid draft. Try describing the skill differently.
errors.unknown: We could not confirm the result. No second request was sent; check Mine in a moment.
errors.stillRunning: The draft is still being created. Check Mine in a moment.
errors.generic: The draft could not be created. Try again.
